You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Slide In Slide, you need to arrange the numbered cards, aiming to score as few points as possible. But watch out, you’ll need to keep an eye on your opponents and be one step ahead to win the game! Setup: Shuffle and deal 16 cards,face down, to each player. Arrange your cards into a 4 by 4 square. This is your grid. Return any remaining cards to the box. Decide who will play first and give them the First Player token. Playing the game: Slide is played over 16 rounds. The game ends when all cards have been revealed and played. Each round, players choose any face-down card from their grid and turns it face-up, in the middle of the table, at the same time. Starting with the first player and continuing clockwise, each player chooses one of the cards from the middle of the table and places it in their grid. To place a card in your grid, push (slide) the card into a row or column to fill an empty space and rebuild the 4 by 4 grid. You cannot slide cards diagonally. You cannot place a card directly into an empty slot. The First Player counter passes to the player on the left and a new round begins. When every card has been turned over, count up the scores. End of the game: All orthogonally adjacent cards with the same number cancel each other out and are removed from the game. Each player counts up the values of the remaining cards in their grid. The player with the lowest score wins the game. In case of a tie, the tied players count up the number of cards remaining in their grid. The player with the fewest cards in their grid wins. If the game is still tied, those players share the victory. Number of players: 2 - 6 Game duration: 8 mn Complexity: 1 / 5 Play Slide and 1414 other games online. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Overview The goal of the game is to put number tiles next to each other so numbers are touching the same numbers (e.g., 2 or more tiles with the number 7 on them are touching each other at the end). Any number not next to a tile with the same number will count against you. You'll do a blind draw of cards with numbers 1-10 from your hidden grid. Then you'll select from the revealed cards to slowly form a grid of tiles so by the end as many tiles as possible touch another tile with the same number. Cards are numbered from 1 to 10, and there are 10 of each number. Turn All players simultaneously pick a card from their grid blind and play it to the table In turn order, players pick a revealed card and add it to their grid by placing it on an edge which is on the same row or column as the empty space and pushing all cards inwards to fill it The first player token is then passed leftwards and start a new turn Game End The game ends when all 16 cards are revealed and played All orthogonal cards of the same value are discarded- note, they must be next to each other. The cards remaining in each player's grid are subtracted and make up their score. The player with the highest score wins! (least negative) If tied, the player with the fewest cards in their grid wins! [Rating: 3/10] The only choices you get here are picking a spot you'll slide a faceup number into and then the choice of how to have the least bad turn when you get to actually pick a face up number. I think this is basically entirely a luck driven game, as any strategy here would be like... picking a card that is the same number as the ones next to the slot you have open. It isn't strategy, it's the only good play. It's a shame, it feels like there is a more interesting game with better choices here in these mechanisms...
